title: Own T=0 SCHC sender sessions in an atomic link-bound registry
description: ACK redesign correctness review found per-FragmentSender value contexts do not enforce one active T=0 session per ordered local signer, remote signer, and directional Rule ID. Two senders can overlap and accept the same verified ACK; delayed prior-session C=1 can terminate a new transfer. Add a link/session-owned atomic registry that captures authoritative replay baseline, rejects overlap, retains terminal tombstones/hold-down, handles counter exhaustion/rekey, and tests simultaneous senders plus late prior-session controls.
